title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). AstroVink-TREX: Automated strong gravitational lens segmentation as input for mass modelling pipelines
summary: Strong gravitational lens modelling requires the lens light, lensed source light, and contaminants to be separated in each image before mass modelling codes can fit the system. Within Euclid this separation has so far been done by hand, which does not scale to the more than 15,000 candidates in the Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) catalogue of Data Release 1 (DR1). We present AstroVink-TREX , a neural network that performs this separation automatically and predicts three flux maps, in a standard format directly usable by mass-modelling pipelines. The network uses a hybrid architecture, pairing a vision transformer encoder reused from the lens detection network with a parallel convolutional branch. A custom loss function penalises both flux and structural error, while allowing independent weighting per component. From the network's predictions we also derive the modelling centre, fitting region, conjugate points, and binary maps, providing all the inputs that a modelling pipeline needs to run without manual setup. We evaluate the efficiency of the network on DR1 systems against existing fits and through expert validation. Across approximately 3000 inspected systems, taking 75% agreement between inspectors, just 39 lens models fail because of a segmentation error. Following this validation, the network provides the component separation and modelling setup for every system modelled in DR1. With automated segmentation, lens modelling is no longer limited by manual preprocessing and can now operate at the same scale as lens discovery.

title: The mass density slope of early-type galaxies: newest results from the redshift distribution of strong gravitational lenses
summary: The mass distribution of early-type galaxies (ETGs) encodes key information about baryonic processes and dark-matter assembly. In this paper, we propose a new framework to investigate the mass-density profiles of ETGs and their evolution with redshift, based on the redshift distribution of strong gravitational lenses. We compile 200 galaxy-scale strong lensing systems with complete information, including lens and source redshifts, Einstein radii, and spectroscopic velocity dispersions. To account for the heterogeneous construction of the compiled sample, we model a lens-redshift-dependent selection function for each survey category. By combining the lens-redshift distribution with velocity dispersion function (VDF) and spherical Jeans-based mapping, we obtain population-level constraints on the total mass-density slope gamma in three lens-redshift intervals, marginalizing over the luminosity-density slope delta and the stellar orbital anisotropy beta. We find that the total mass density of ETGs remains close to isothermal at low and intermediate redshifts ($γ=2.00^{+0.07}_{-0.15}$ at 0 < z_l < 0.5 and $γ=1.96^{+0.16}_{-0.26}$ at 0.5 < z_l < 0.6), with a shallower effective slope at higher redshift ($γ=1.81^{+0.17}_{-0.21}$ at $0.6<z_l\lesssim1.0$). The marginalized posteriors of delta and beta remain broad, consistent with $δ\simeq2$ and with isotropic orbits in all three redshift intervals. These results are consistent with the redshift trend predicted by Horizon-AGN simulations, in which active galactic nucleus (AGN) feedback, together with stellar assembly and merging, contributes to the structural evolution of ETGs. Applied to the much larger lens samples expected from future missions such as the Chinese Space Station Telescope (CSST), this method will enable tighter tests of density-slope evolution and its connection to galaxy formation processes.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 早型星系（ETGs）的质量分布编码了关于重子过程和暗物质组装的关键信息。本文提出了一种新框架，基于强引力透镜的红移分布来研究ETGs的质量密度轮廓及其随红移的演化。我们汇编了200个信息完备的星系尺度强透镜系统，包括透镜和源的红移、爱因斯坦半径以及光谱速度弥散。为了考虑汇编样本的异质性构建，我们为每个巡天类别建模了一个依赖于透镜红移的选择函数。通过将透镜红移分布与速度弥散函数（VDF）以及基于球面Jeans方程的映射相结合，我们在三个透镜红移区间获得了对总质量密度斜率gamma的群体级约束，同时对光度密度斜率delta和恒星轨道各向异性beta进行了边缘化。我们发现ETGs的总质量密度在低和中等红移处保持接近等温（在0 < z_l < 0.5时$γ=2.00^{+0.07}_{-0.15}$，在0.5 < z_l < 0.6时$γ=1.96^{+0.16}_{-0.26}$），在更高红移处有效斜率变浅（在$0.6<z_l\lesssim1.0$时$γ=1.81^{+0.17}_{-0.21}$）。delta和beta的边缘化后验仍然宽泛，与$δ\simeq2$以及所有三个红移区间内的各向同性轨道一致。这些结果与Horizon-AGN模拟预测的红移趋势一致，其中活动星系核（AGN）反馈连同恒星组装和并合共同促进了ETGs的结构演化。应用于未来任务如中国空间站望远镜（CSST）预期提供的更大透镜样本，该方法将能够更严格地检验密度斜率演化及其与星系形成过程的联系。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：早型星系总质量密度在低、中红移近似等温，高红移下有效斜率变浅，表明存在结构演化；该趋势与AGN反馈叠加恒星组装和并合的模拟预期一致。该方法可推广到未来CSST等更大透镜样本，用于更严格地检验密度斜率演化及其与星系形成过程的联系。

title: Multipoles in the IllustrisTNG simulation galaxies and implications for Strong Gravitational Lens modelling in Time-delay Cosmography
summary: Time-delay cosmography is a powerful independent probe of the Hubble constant ($H_0$), yet reaching the sub-2$\%$ precision required to resolve the Hubble tension demands a rigorous treatment of mass model systematics. We use realistic massive elliptical galaxies from the IllustrisTNG hydrodynamic simulation suite to characterise higher-order angular mass complexity in the form of multipoles ($m=1,3,4$) and quantify their impact on $H_0$ inference. We find that these multipole perturbations are common and emergent features of galaxy assembly; in 51$\%$ of our total samples ($54\%$ TNG100-1 galaxies and $85\%$ for TNG50-1 galaxies), the addition of multipole terms to a standard elliptical power-law model is preferred by the Bayesian Information Criterion. Ignoring these structures in lens modelling introduces systematic biases in $H_0$: for perturbations of $\sim2\%$, the biases are of the order of 1--2$\%$ for $m=1$, 4--5$\%$ for $m=3$, and 3--6$\%$ for $m=4$ multipole. While the $m=4$ (boxy/discyness) mode induces a predictable directional bias, odd-order modes ($m=1,3$) introduce significant stochastic scatter. We demonstrate a degeneracy where unmodelled internal multipoles can be effectively absorbed by the external shear component. This combined with low signal-to-noise observations can create ``hidden biases'' where formally perfect fits to imaging data ($χ_ν^2 \approx 1$) could harbour significant cosmological errors. Our results provide an astrophysical basis for multipole priors and highlight the necessity of moving beyond rigid parametric models to achieve high-accuracy cosmography in the era of \textit{Euclid} and LSST.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Enhancing deep-learning models: the impact of image processing and training data selection for strong-lens detection
summary: Euclid is expected to discover ~$10^5$ galaxy-galaxy strong gravitational lenses across ~14,000deg$^2$, requiring automated searches with high completeness and low false-positive rates. Despite advances in deep learning, the effects of training-set composition, image representation, and preprocessing on survey-scale detection remain poorly understood. We present an ablation study of the convolutional neural network used in the ECLIPSE strong-lens detection pipeline, evaluating different training configurations on a fixed test set. Using simulated and real Euclid data, we compare VIS-only and pseudo-RGB representations, FITS and JPEG formats, training-set composition, hard-negative selection, and multi-stage training. We also assess ensembling on ~67 million DR1 cutouts. Training-set composition and strategy strongly affect high-Recall performance. Omitting simulation based pre-training reduces high-Recall weighted average Precision by 83.7% for VIS-only and 74.5% for pseudo-RGB models. Negative-sample selection also substantially affects performance, while FITS yields modest gains over JPEG at high Recall (~2-5%). On DR1, the logit-mean ensemble improves average Precision by 28.0% and 39.9% over the individual VIS-only and pseudo-RGB models. Among ~70,000 candidates selected for visual inspection, it recovers 11,256 unique grade A (secure) and B (probable) lenses, compared with 9650 and 10,395 for the individual models. The branches show complementary ranking preferences, particularly for lenses benefiting from near-infrared information. Careful training-set design, realistic negatives, and multi-band ensembling improve survey-scale searches. Our final ensemble achieves ~80% Recall at the operational selection threshold, outperforming ablation models with higher global classification metrics and highlighting the need to optimise performance for realistic survey conditions.[Abridged]

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Double-source-plane lens candidates
summary: Strong gravitational-lensing systems with multiple source planes are powerful tools for probing the stellar and dark matter content of galaxies. Lens modelling can measure the relative Einstein radii of the two source planes, which encode a ratio of angular-diameter distances determined by the lens and source redshifts and the dark energy equation of state, independently of the Hubble constant. Galaxy-scale double-source-plane lenses (DSPLs) are extremely rare. We present a sample of 84 galaxy-scale DSPL candidates in Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1), of which 80 are newly identified. These systems were selected using machine-learning lens-finding models followed by visual inspection by citizen scientists and experts. We then used lens modelling to test the DSPL interpretation. Among our lens candidates, 11 form the 'Gold' sample: each shows two sets of multiple images at different radii, and the observed configuration is reproduced by a DSPL lens model. The remaining 73 'Silver' candidates have at least two lensed arcs from visual inspection, but either lack multiple images for at least one arc, have a best-fitting DSPL distance ratio close to the single-source-plane limit, remain compatible with a single-plane model with multiple sources, or have not yet been modelled. Even if all 84 candidates are DSPLs, the sample falls below the approximately 90 systems expected from extrapolating the Euclid Quick Data Release 1 (Q1) yield and the approximately 200 obtained by scaling the LensPop forecast to the DR1 area, indicating that many DSPLs remain undetected in DR1. Spectroscopy or higher-resolution imaging is required before we can be confident that the Silver candidates are DSPLs.

title: Magnolia: a highly magnetized galaxy at redshift $z\simeq9$
comment: Submitted to A&A after the first referee report, comments welcome
summary: The theory of galactic magnetic field growth via dynamo action predicts that the interstellar medium (ISM) of early galaxies would remain virtually unmagnetized on large scales. However, recent observations of strong dust polarization in galaxies at redshifts $z\simeq2.6$ and $z\simeq5.6$ challenge this paradigm. If galaxies indeed host strong, large-scale, coherent magnetic fields at high-$z$, then galaxy evolution and current theories of magnetic field amplification in galaxies should be revisited. To address the full physical complexity of early magnetic field growth in galaxies, we have designed MAGNA SERRA, a suite of radiation-magneto-hydrodynamical (RMHD) cosmological zoom-in simulations with non-equilibrium chemistry. In this first paper from the MAGNA SERRA suite, we present Magnolia, a galaxy hosted in a $\simeq 10^{11}~\mathrm{M}_\odot$ dark matter halo simulated with RAMSES-RT with a $\simeq 10^4~\mathrm{M}_\odot$ mass ($\simeq 10 \,\mathrm{pc}$ spatial) resolution. We find that, at $z\simeq9$, Magnolia has a stellar mass of a few times $10^8~\mathrm{M}_\odot$ and is strongly magnetized, reaching a magnetic field of a few $μG$ and a plasma beta $β\simeq 0.1$ in the densest regions. This strong amplification occurs over a timescale of about 40~Myrs due to the highly dynamical nature of the galaxy, which creates strong compressions and shear. The power spectra of the magnetic and kinetic energies and the spectral energy transfer functions do not suggest dynamo action, but rather an initial magnetic field amplification through a large-scale compression, and a later re-organization of this field from small to large scales. Our findings show that strong galactic magnetization is possible at very high redshifts, which means that magnetic fields can play a dominant role throughout a galaxy's evolutionary history. title: Fuzzy Dark Matter as a diffractive barrier: Wave-optics Signatures of Ultralight Fields on Lensed Gravitational Waves
summary: Gravitational waves (GWs) propagate through the universe from sources at high redshift, experiencing the gravitational fields of the intervening matter distribution. Halos composed of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) contain strong density fluctuations, reflecting the interference pattern in the field distribution of the ultralight bosons. In the wave-optics regime, ULDM fluctuations act as a diffractive grating, imprinting frequency-dependent modulations of GWs, in addition to magnification and other gravitational lensing effects. Since lensing depends on the projected surface density, we derive its approximate probability distribution and show how it departs from a Gaussian distribution depending on the halo profile and coherence length. We then quantify how the GW diffraction signatures produced by the granules depend on macroimage magnification and parity. The ULDM interference network imprints stochastic diffraction fluctuations at the $O(1)\%$ level on GWs moderately lensed by the host when the Fresnel scale is comparable to the granule coherence length $r_F(f)\sim\ell_c$. These fluctuations can be enhanced to $\gtrsim10\%$ when the host macroimage forms near the critical curve or for Type II macroimages. For massive black hole binaries observed by LISA, the diffraction signature can be detectable around the ULDM particle mass $m_φ\sim10^{-21}$ eV, providing either a smoking-gun signature of ULDM or new constraints on $m_φ$.

AI.tldr: 超轻暗物质（ULDM）晕的干涉图样在波光学区域充当衍射光栅，对引力波（GW）产生随频率变化的调制，本文推导了透镜面密度分布的近似概率分布（偏离高斯）并量化了衍射特征对宏观像放大率与宇称的依赖，指出在宿主晕中等透镜下可留下 O(1)% 的随机衍射涨落，临界曲线附近或Type II像可达 ≳10%，LISA 对 \(m_\phi\sim10^{-21}\) eV 可探测。
AI.motivation: GW 从高红移源传播时会穿过前景物质引力场；若暗物质为超轻玻色子，其晕内存在强密度涨落（场的干涉图样），在波光学区域应表现为对 GW 的额外频率依赖调制。作者希望厘清这些衍射签名的大小、统计性质及其对透镜构型的依赖，并评估其可探测性。
AI.method: 解析与半解析建模：将 ULDM 涨落视为衍射光栅，在波光学框架下处理 GW 传播；基于投影面密度导出透镜（放大率等）的近似概率分布，并考察其相对高斯的偏离如何随晕剖面与相干长度变化；进而分析衍射信号对宏观像放大率与宇称（Type I/II）的依赖，比较菲涅耳尺度 \(r_F(f)\) 与颗粒相干长度 \(\ell_c\)。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 引力波（GWs）从高红移源在宇宙中传播，经历中间物质分布的引力场。由超轻暗物质（ULDM）组成的晕包含强密度涨落，反映了超轻玻色子场分布中的干涉图案。在波动光学区域，ULDM涨落充当衍射光栅，除了放大和其他引力透镜效应外，还对GWs施加频率依赖的调制。由于透镜效应取决于投影表面密度，我们推导了其近似概率分布，并展示了它如何根据晕轮廓和相干长度偏离高斯分布。然后我们量化了颗粒产生的GW衍射特征如何依赖于宏观像放大率和宇称。当菲涅尔尺度与颗粒相干长度相当（$r_F(f)\sim\ell_c$）时，ULDM干涉网络在宿主中等透镜化的GWs上印下$O(1)\%$水平的随机衍射涨落。当宿主宏观像形成于临界曲线附近或对于Type II宏观像时，这些涨落可以增强到$\gtrsim10\%$。对于LISA观测到的 massive black hole binaries，衍射特征在ULDM粒子质量$m_φ\sim10^{-21}$ eV附近可探测，提供ULDM的确凿证据或对$m_φ$的新限制。

title: Weak lensing data beyond flexion
summary: In weak lensing, shear and convergence are well studied and have provided a wealth of information about the distribution of matter in the universe. More recently, flexion -- the next term in the multipole expansion of the lensing potential, responsible for the characteristic banana-shaped distortion of lensed images -- has been shown to provide additional constraints on the mass distribution of lensing systems, particularly for galaxy clusters. Here we investigate whether weak-lensing information beyond flexion is similarly useful for lens-mass reconstruction. Using the roulette-amplitude formalism, we construct synthetic datasets for a single SIE lens and for SIE and SIS cluster lenses, with and without simulated Gaussian noise, and perform a least-squares reconstruction of the lens parameters using amplitudes truncated at third (flexion), fourth, and fifth order. As a proof of concept, we find that higher-order amplitudes do provide additional, useful information: the benefit is modest for a single lens, where flexion already constrains most parameters, but becomes substantial for cluster lenses, where the rotation and ellipticity are otherwise poorly recovered. The improvement is most pronounced in the presence of noise, where third-order reconstruction can become unreliable while higher-order amplitudes restore much of the lost accuracy. These results suggest that, as weak-lensing surveys grow in depth and precision, data beyond flexion could meaningfully improve mass reconstruction for the most complex and noisiest lensing systems, motivating further work using observational rather than synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 本文检验弱引力透镜多极展开中高于flexion（四阶、五阶）的振幅是否也能用于透镜质量重建。结果表明：高阶振幅确实提供有用信息，对单透镜增益有限，但对星系团透镜（尤其是含噪声情形）显著改善了旋转角与椭率的恢复。
AI.motivation: 剪切与收敛度已被充分研究，flexion（三阶）也被证明能为透镜系统（尤其星系团）的质量分布提供额外约束。作者由此追问：比flexion更高阶的弱透镜信息是否同样对透镜质量重建有用，这一方向此前缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 采用roulette-amplitude形式体系，为单个SIE透镜以及SIE、SIS星系团透镜构造合成数据集（含与不含模拟高斯噪声），分别用截断至三阶（flexion）、四阶、五阶的振幅做透镜参数的最小二乘重建，并比较重建效果。采用合成数据属概念验证性质。
AI.result: 高阶振幅确实带来额外且有用的信息。对单透镜增益温和，因为flexion已能约束大部分参数；对星系团透镜增益明显，因为其旋转角与椭率原本恢复较差。在含噪声情形下改善最突出：三阶重建可能变得不可靠，而高阶振幅能恢复大部分损失的精度。
AI.conclusion: 随着弱透镜巡天的深度与精度提升，超出flexion的数据有望切实改善最复杂、噪声最大的透镜系统的质量重建。作者据此呼吁后续用真实观测数据（而非纯合成数据）进一步验证。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在弱引力透镜中，剪切和会聚已被充分研究，并为宇宙中物质分布提供了丰富信息。最近，flexion——透镜势多极展开中的下一项，负责透镜像特有的香蕉形畸变——已被证明能为透镜系统的质量分布提供额外约束，特别是对星系团。本文研究超出flexion的弱透镜信息是否同样有助于透镜质量重建。利用轮盘振幅形式，我们为单个SIE透镜以及SIE和SIS星系团透镜构建了合成数据集，包含和不包含模拟高斯噪声，并使用截断至三阶（flexion）、四阶和五阶的振幅进行透镜参数的最小二乘重建。作为概念验证，我们发现高阶振幅确实提供了额外的有用信息：对于单个透镜，收益是适度的，因为flexion已经约束了大多数参数；但对于星系团透镜，收益变得显著，因为否则旋转和椭率恢复得很差。这种改进在存在噪声时最为明显，此时三阶重建可能变得不可靠，而高阶振幅恢复了大部分丢失的精度。这些结果表明，随着弱透镜巡天的深度和精度提高，超出flexion的数据可能有意义地改善最复杂和噪声最大的透镜系统的质量重建，这激励了使用观测数据而非合成数据的进一步工作。

title: Probing the Activity History of Repeating Fast Radio Bursts with Cluster Lensing
summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond duration coherent radio transients, some of whose sources repeat, but the nature and active lifetimes of their engines remain uncertain. Strong lensing by galaxy clusters provides a physical lever on this lifetime problem: a short campaign can sample emission epochs of a repeating FRB separated by years, and distinct bursts in different lensed images, given a known relative lens delay, set a lower bound on its active lifetime, whereas delayed copies of a single burst only encode the lens delay. Based on the cluster-lens model of MACS J0717.5+3745, we quantify the accessible range of emission epochs for finite activity episodes, observing windows, and discovery selection. For a source-frame episode of duration \(100~{\rm yr}\) at \(z_s=2\) and a source-frame rate of \(0.1\,{\rm h}_{\rm src}^{-1}\), a five year campaign conditional on discovery yields a \(95\%\) gain threshold of \(m_{95}\simeq25.6\), corresponding to a source-frame span of \(L_{95}\simeq42.6~{\rm yr}\). At the population level, combining distinct burst associations with same burst echoes provides a way to test specified activity durations with a finite lens catalogue, e.g., activity durations differing by an order of magnitude can be distinguished with expected Bayes factor above $20$. More broadly, these lensed source frame epochs enable applications beyond activity-duration tests, e.g., linking burst activity to the evolution of the engine and its environment. Galaxy-cluster lensing therefore provides a promising future probe for accessing otherwise unobserved source history and for distinguishing between different activity duration models.

title: Precise Deep-Learning Reconstruction of Galaxy Cluster Mass Maps and Substructures from Optical Observations
summary: Accurately mapping the total mass distribution within galaxy clusters, including dark matter, is fundamental to understanding structure formation and constraining cosmological parameters. Conventional mass-mapping techniques rely predominantly on gravitational lensing and often produce smooth mass distributions based on analytical profiles, potentially missing important internal substructures. We introduce a complementary, simulation-based inference approach to reconstruct detailed galaxy cluster mass maps and resolve their internal substructures directly from optical imaging. We trained deep learning models on realistic hydrodynamical simulations of galaxy clusters to infer their mass distributions from optical observations. We subsequently applied this framework to observations of real galaxy clusters obtained with the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) as part of the Cluster Lensing And Supernova survey with Hubble (CLASH) programme. The reconstructed mass maps successfully reproduce the overall shapes and radial mass profiles of the CLASH clusters, showing strong agreement with independent gravitational lensing measurements. Furthermore, the subhalo mass functions derived from the reconstructed maps exhibit power-law behaviour broadly consistent with predictions from numerical simulations. Our results demonstrate that combining optical imaging with deep learning provides a scalable and physically meaningful approach to mapping galaxy cluster mass distributions. This framework opens a new avenue for exploiting upcoming wide-field imaging surveys to systematically investigate dark matter substructures across large cluster samples, complementing traditional gravitational lensing techniques. Moreover, the model is inherently flexible and can incorporate multi-wavelength observations, including X-ray and Sunyaev--Zel'dovich data, to further improve total mass predictions.

All panels share the same field of view, line of sight, and corresponding color bar scales.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：来自The300模拟的一个示例星系团的质量和模拟HST光度图。左上：投影总质量分布（ \(\log_{10}M_{\odot}\) ）。其余面板：在共享对数尺度上的F606W、F625W、F775W、F814W和F850LP滤光片的模拟HST光学光度图。所有面板共享相同的视场、视线和相应的色标尺度。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3 : Schematic of the convolutional block (top) and Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) layer (bottom) implemented in the U-Net architecture. Each convolutional block contains two sets of convolutional layers ( \(F=f\) filters), batch normalization, and ReLU activation functions, used across both down-sampling and up-sampling paths. The FiLM layer modulates the bottleneck and decoder feature maps to condition the network on cluster redshift \(z\) using learned scale \(\gamma(z)\) and shift \(\beta(z)\) parameters.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：U-Net架构中实现的卷积块（上）和特征级线性调制（FiLM）层（下）的示意图。每个卷积块包含两组卷积层（ \(F=f\) 个滤波器）、批归一化和ReLU激活函数，用于下采样和上采样路径。FiLM层调制瓶颈和解码器特征图，使用学习到的尺度 \(\gamma(z)\) 和偏移 \(\beta(z)\) 参数使网络以星系团红移 \(z\) 为条件。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Single-channel U-Net architecture for processing individual \(128\times 128\times 1\) HST filter images (F606W, F625W, F775W, F814W, or F850LP). The network compresses the input through a four-stage encoder (starting with \(F=32\) filters) to a bottleneck, followed by a symmetric decoder path with skip connections to reconstruct the final projected mass map. Each stage utilizes the convolutional block shown in Fig. 3 . Redshift conditioning is integrated at the bottleneck and throughout the decoder using FiLM layers to modulate the latent feature maps, capturing redshift-dependent features.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：用于处理单个 \(128\times 128\times 1\) HST滤光片图像（F606W、F625W、F775W、F814W或F850LP）的单通道U-Net架构。网络通过四阶段编码器（从 \(F=32\) 个滤波器开始）将输入压缩到瓶颈，然后通过带有跳跃连接的对称解码器路径重建最终投影质量图。每个阶段利用图3所示的卷积块。红移条件通过FiLM层在瓶颈和整个解码器中集成，以调制潜在特征图，捕捉红移相关特征。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5 : Multi-encoder U-Net architecture for simultaneous processing of five HST filter images (F606W, F625W, F775W, F814W, and F850LP) of the same cluster. Each \(128\times 128\times 1\) input passes through an independent encoder branch ( \(3\times 3\) kernels, base filter size \(F=32\) ). The resulting feature maps are concatenated at the bottleneck into a joint latent representation and conditioned on cluster redshift via a FiLM layer. A shared decoder then reconstructs the final projected mass map, utilizing FiLM modulation at each stage and multi-branch skip connections to preserve spatial information.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：用于同时处理同一星系团的五个HST滤光片图像（F606W、F625W、F775W、F814W和F850LP）的多编码器U-Net架构。每个 \(128\times 128\times 1\) 输入通过独立的编码器分支（ \(3\times 3\) 核，基础滤波器大小 \(F=32\) ）。所得特征图在瓶颈处拼接成联合潜在表示，并通过FiLM层以星系团红移为条件。然后，共享解码器重建最终投影质量图，在每个阶段利用FiLM调制和多分支跳跃连接以保留空间信息。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6 : Performance of different U-Net models in predicting projected total mass maps for a representative cluster from the simulation test set. Top panel shows the reconstructed maps, and lower panel shows the corresponding relative error residual maps, defined as \((\Sigma_{\text{2D, pred}}-\Sigma_{\text{2D, true}})/\Sigma_{\text{2D, true}}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图6：不同U-Net模型在预测模拟测试集中一个代表性星系团的投影总质量图方面的性能。上面板显示重建图，下面板显示相应的相对误差残差图，定义为 \((\Sigma_{\text{2D, pred}}-\Sigma_{\text{2D, true}})/\Sigma_{\text{2D, true}}\) 。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7 : Comparison of ground truth and predicted mass maps from different U-Net models over the test dataset. The upper panels show surface mass density radial profiles, whereas, the lower panels show power spectra estimated from the mass maps. Solid lines represent the test set medians, and shaded regions show the \(16^{th}\text{--}84^{th}\) percentile range; each subplot compares an individual U-Net architecture against the ground truth. Vertical black dotted lines indicate the spatial resolution of The300 simulations ( \(\approx 6.5\) kpc, top) and the Nyquist limit of the \(128\times 128\) pixel mass maps ( \(k\approx 0.8\penalty\ \text{kpc}^{-1}\) or \(\lambda\approx 7.85\) kpc, bottom).
figures.caption_zh: 图7：在测试数据集上，不同U-Net模型的地面真值和预测质量图的比较。上面板显示表面质量密度径向轮廓，而下面板显示从质量图估计的功率谱。实线表示测试集中位数，阴影区域显示 \(16^{th}\text{--}84^{th}\) 百分位范围；每个子图将单个U-Net架构与地面真值进行比较。垂直黑色虚线表示The300模拟的空间分辨率（ \(\approx 6.5\) kpc，上）和 \(128\times 128\) 像素质量图的奈奎斯特极限（ \(k\approx 0.8\penalty\ \text{kpc}^{-1}\) 或 \(\lambda\approx 7.85\) kpc，下）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8 : Overall performance of the U-Net models in reconstructing total matter distributions. The top panel compares the predicted total projected mass from different U-Net models against the ground truth across the entire simulation test set; red dotted lines denote the ideal 1:1 relation, and blue contours show the kernel density estimation. The bottom panel displays the pixel-wise relative error distribution between predictions and true values for all test set maps, with the legend indicating the mean error and \(\pm 1\sigma\) standard deviation for each architecture.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：U-Net模型在重建总物质分布方面的整体性能。上面板比较了整个模拟测试集中不同U-Net模型预测的总投影质量与地面真值；红色虚线表示理想的1:1关系，蓝色轮廓显示核密度估计。下面板显示了所有测试集图的预测值与真实值之间的像素级相对误差分布，图例指示每种架构的平均误差和 \(\pm 1\sigma\) 标准差。
